plugins.description: Turn AI activity into business impact with your own agent and material. Frame intent before specification with outcomes, assumptions, and leading indicators; assess initiative readiness, portfolio patterns, AI traction, operating-model reality, flow metrics, and WIP. Produce usable evidence for the next decision while coaching through the work.
